summary_en: Notification of the Congregation 'on some aspects of proper calendars and proper liturgical texts' (Notificazione su alcuni aspetti dei calendari e dei testi liturgici propri), signed 20 September 1997, no protocol printed. Operative rules: a celebration entered in a particular calendar keeps the day it has in the General Calendar even if its grade changes (n. 5); the Congregation will no longer grant transfers of General Calendar celebrations impeded in a particular calendar except for exceptional pastoral reasons affecting many faithful, and the impeded celebration is transferred rather than the impeding one (nn. 12-13); a solemnity grade for the principal diocesan patron is contrary to the Table of Liturgical Days and discouraged (n. 19); in a religious calendar only one of Title, Founder or principal Patron may be a solemnity, the other two being feasts, and a Blessed founder gets the grade of feast (n. 20); only one patron may be chosen under the 1973 Normae de Patronis (n. 21); new Blesseds should be entered only in geographically limited calendars, preferably as optional memorials (nn. 28-32); celebrations of religious institutes are not to be added to diocesan calendars (nn. 34-37).
excerpt:
NOTIFICAZIONE SU ALCUNI ASPETTI DEI CALENDARI E DEI TESTI LITURGICI PROPRI
12. Per il futuro, quindi, la Congregazione intende insistere di più sulla necessità di mantenere le celebrazioni del Calendario Generale al giorno loro assegnato, e di non concedere il trasferimento ad altro giorno delle celebrazioni impedienti, se non per motivi pastorali eccezionali, che interessino un considerevole numero di fedeli.
Memoria dei SS. Andrea Kim Taegon e Compagni, martiri, 20 settembre 1997. Jorge Medina Estévez, Arcivescovo Pro-Prefetto

excerpt: Siervas de Jesús de la Caridad: conceditur ut festum Beatae Mariae Iosephae a Corde Iesu Sancho de Guerra, virginis et fundatricis, a die 20 martii ad diem 18 maii transferatur (6 mar. 1997, Prot. 1881/92).

celebration.name_latin: Sanctus Alfonsus Maria de' Liguori, episcopus et Ecclesiae doctor

summary_en: For the Pontifical Interregional Seminary of Campania (Italy), St Alphonsus Mary de' Liguori, bishop and doctor of the Church, on 28 April as a solemnity (a single institution, listed under '5. Alia').
excerpt: Pontificio Seminario Interregionale della Campania: 28 aprilis, Sancti Alfonsi Mariae de' Liguori, episcopi et Ecclesiae doctoris, sollemnitas (4 ian. 1997, prot. 2084/96/L).

summary_en: St Sebastian, martyr, is confirmed as patron of the city of Ciudad Rodrigo (Spain).
excerpt: Sanctus Sebastianus, martyr: Patronus civitatis Roderici (Ciudad Rodrigo), Spagna (7 ian. 1997, Prot. 2483/96/L).

summary_en: Blessed Hroznata, martyr, is confirmed as patron of the diocese of Plzeň (Czech Republic).
excerpt: Beatus Hroznata, martyr: Patronus Dioecesis Pilsinensis, Repubblica Ceca (9 ian. 1997, Prot. 2269/96/L).

celebration.name_latin: Sancta Teresia a Iesu Jornet Ibars, virgo

summary_en: St Teresa of Jesus Jornet Ibars, virgin, is confirmed as patroness of the elderly of the Dominican Republic (patron of a category of persons).
excerpt: Sancta Teresia a Iesu Jornet Ibars, virgo: Patrona senum Dominicanae Reipublicae (18 mar. 1997, Prot. 378/97/L).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Antonia Bandrés y Elóasegui, virgo

summary_en: Blessed Mary Antonia Bandrés y Elósegui, virgin, is confirmed as patroness of the houses of formation of the Congregation 'Hijas de Jesús' (patron of the formation houses only, not of the whole institute).
excerpt: Beata Maria Antonia Bandrés y Elóasegui, virgo: Patrona domorum formationis Congregationis v.d. «Hijas de Jesús» (9 apr. 1997, Prot. 651/97/L).

summary_en: St Paschal Baylon, religious, is confirmed as patron of the municipality of Furore, archdiocese of Amalfi-Cava de' Tirreni (Italy).
excerpt: Sanctus Paschal Baylon, religiosus: Patronus municipii v.d. «Furore», Amalfi-Cava de' Tirreni, Italia (3 maii 1997, Prot. 884/97/L).

summary_en: St Bernardine of Siena, priest, is confirmed as secondary patron of the diocese of Massa Marittima-Piombino (Italy); the same protocol gives him an obligatory memorial on 20 May in the diocesan calendar (separate entry).
excerpt: Sanctus Bernardus Senensis, presbyter: Patronus secundarius dioecesis Massanae-Pumblinensis, Italia (5 maii 1997, Prot. 2353/96/L).

summary_en: St Pius X, pope, is confirmed as patron of the Congregation of the Oblate Sisters of Christ the Priest; the same protocol approves their proper calendar (separate entry).
excerpt: Sanctus Pius X, papa: Patronus Congregationis v.g. «Hermanas Oblatas de Cristo Sacerdote» (7 maii 1997, Prot. 363/97/L).

celebration.name_latin: Sanctus Petrus Caelestinus, papa et eremita

summary_en: St Peter Celestine, pope and hermit, is confirmed as secondary patron of the region of Molise (Italy), a sub-national region.
excerpt: Sanctus Petrus Caelestinus, papa et eremita: Patronus secundarius Molisanae regionis, Italia (10 maii 1997, Prot. 870/97/L).

summary_en: Blessed Honorat Koźmiński, priest, is confirmed as patron of the town of Nowe Miasto, diocese of Łowicz (Poland).
excerpt: Beatus Honoratus Kozminski, presbyter: Patronus civitatis v.g. «Nowe Miasto», Lowicz, Polonia (17 maii 1997, Prot. 352/97/L).

summary_en: One decree confirms ten patrons for the armed forces of El Salvador: St John of Capistrano for the military chaplains; the Immaculate Virgin Mary for the infantry; St George for the cavalry; St Barbara for the artillery; St Ferdinand for the engineers; St Gabriel the Archangel for the signals corps; St Joseph for the commissariat and administration; Our Lady of Perpetual Help for the health service; Our Lady of Loreto for the air force; Our Lady of Mount Carmel for the navy (patrons of categories of persons).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Antonia Bandrés y Elóasegui, virgo

summary_en: For the Daughters of Jesus (Hijas de Jesús), liturgical celebrations are granted in honour of Blessed Mary Antonia Bandrés y Elósegui, virgin (the page prints the surname as 'Bandrés y Elm Beati', evidently a typesetting slip; the text confirmations under the same protocol print 'Bandrés y Elóasegui').
excerpt: Figlie di Gesù (v.d. «Hijas de Jesús»): liturgicae celebrationes conceduntur in honorem Beatae Mariae Antoniae Bandrés y Elm Beati, virginis (20 feb. 1997, Prot. 2336/96/L).

summary_en: One-year ruling for 1997: for the dioceses of Bohemia and Moravia (Czech Republic), a Mass in honour of St Adalbert, bishop and martyr, may be celebrated on the Fifth Sunday of Easter 1997 in the churches of those dioceses (millennium of his death).
excerpt: Repubblica Ceca, Diocesi della Bohemia e Moravia: conceditur ut Missa celebretur in honorem Sancti Adalberti, episcopi et martyris, die dominica V Paschae huius anni 1997, in ecclesiis eorumdem dioecesium (8 apr. 1997, Prot. 103/97/L).

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Florentinus Asensio Barroso, episcopus et martyr

summary_en: For the diocese of Barbastro-Monzón (Spain), liturgical celebrations are granted in honour of the newly beatified Florentino Asensio Barroso, bishop and martyr.
excerpt: Barbastro-Monzón, Spagna: liturgicae celebrationes conceduntur in honorem novi Beati Florentini Asensio Barroso, episcopi et martyris (28 apr. 1997, Prot. 501/97/L).

summary_en: For Spain, liturgical celebrations are granted in honour of the newly beatified Ceferino Jiménez Malla, martyr.
excerpt: Hispania: liturgicae celebrationes conceduntur in honorem novi Beati Zephyrini Jiménez Malla, martyris (30 apr. 1997, Prot. 311/97/L).

summary_en: For the Camillians, liturgical celebrations are granted in honour of Blessed Enrico Rebuschini, priest.
excerpt: Camilliani: liturgicae celebrationes conceduntur in honorem Beati Henrici Rebuschini, presbyteri (28 apr. 1997, Prot. 537/97/L).

target.institute: Hermanas Bethlemitas Hijas del Sagrado Corazón

summary_en: For the Bethlemite Sisters, Daughters of the Sacred Heart, liturgical celebrations are granted in honour of Blessed Mary of the Incarnation (Vicenta Rosal).
excerpt: Hermanas Bethlemitas Hijas del Sagrado Corazno: liturgicae celebrationes conceduntur in honorem Beatae Mariae ab Incarnatione [Vicenta Rosal] (28 apr. 1997, Prot. 604/97/L).

summary_en: For the Sisters Servants of the Poor (Albertine Sisters), liturgical celebrations are granted in honour of Blessed Bernardina Jabłońska, virgin.
excerpt: Suore Ancelle dei Poveri: liturgicae celebrationes conceduntur in honorem Beatae Bernardinae Jablonska, virginis (29 apr. 1997, Prot. 524/97/L).

target.institute: Suore del Divino Pastore della Divina Provvidenza

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Karlowska, virgo et fundatrix

summary_en: For the Sisters of the Divine Shepherd of Divine Providence, liturgical celebrations are granted in honour of Blessed Maria Karłowska, virgin and foundress.
excerpt: Suore del Divino Pastore della Divina Provvidenza: liturgicae celebrationes conceduntur in honorem Beatae Mariae Karlowska, virginis et fundatricis (30 apr. 1997, Prot. 434/97/L).

summary_en: For the archdiocese of Reggio Calabria-Bova (Italy), liturgical celebrations are granted in honour of Blessed Gaetano Catanoso, priest.
excerpt: Reggio Calabria-Bova, Italia: liturgicae celebrationes conceduntur in honorem Beati Caietani Catanoso, presbyteri (15 maii 1997, Prot. 806/97/L).

summary_en: For the Congregation of the Mission (Lazarists), liturgical celebrations are granted in honour of Blessed Frédéric Ozanam.
excerpt: Lazzaristi: liturgicae celebrationes conceduntur in honorem Beati Frederici Ozanam (16 maii 1997, Prot. 572/97/L).

celebration.name_latin: Sancta Teresia a Iesu Infante, virgo

summary_en: St Therese of the Child Jesus, virgin, was solemnly proclaimed a Doctor of the Church by Pope John Paul II on 19 October 1997; only this notice in the Acta is printed (no decree, no protocol), so the title change in the General Calendar is recorded from it.
excerpt:
PROCLAMATIO DOCTORIS ECCLESIAE
Die 19 octobris, in area quae respicit Basilicam Vaticanam sacrum celebrans, Summus Pontifex Sanctam Teresiam a Iesu Infante, virginem, Doctorem Ecclesiae sollemniter renuntiavit.
